decisions.decision: Muir will file a petition with the MBLC to waive the Municipal Appropriation Requirement, unless the Young Adult Librarian funding is approved.
decisions.quote: muir will be filing a petition with the mblc to waive this requirement.

decisions.decision: Muir will add balances of the non-town-budget accounts (Library Revolving Fund, Library Gift Fund, Library State Aid, Public Library Funds, Library Serv/Tech Grant) to his Director's Report.
decisions.quote: he said he will add these accounts to his report.

decisions.decision: Laura will edit the Library Director job description for a future meeting after the board agreed some changes should be made.
decisions.quote: laura will edit the document for a future meeting.

decisions.decision: The Trustees agreed they would not allow access through the library driveway to the Brooks House lot if it is sold or leased; they favor leasing over selling.
decisions.quote: we agreed we would not allow access.

decisions.decision: Stephen Wallace will report back to the Select Board that the library will not allow access and will share the Trustees' concerns.
decisions.quote: stephen said he will report back to the select board that we will not allow access and let them know our concerns.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Vacation buyouts approved at the May 2026 Annual Town Meeting were charged to salary accounts, and the accounting department will add funds to the library budget to cover the expense; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: the accounting department will make an adjustment to add additional funds to our budget to cover this expense.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY2027 budget is under the state Municipal Appropriation Requirement, and the vacation buyout adjustment could push it back over the requirement.
budget_items.quote: our fy2027 budget is $4k under the municipal appropriation requirement (mar)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager agreed to fund half the cost from town funds if the library funds the other half from State Aid; State Aid has no restrictions on its use. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: the town manager agreed to fund half of the cost from town funds if the library can fund the other half from state aid.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director's Report budget table shows the FY27 total budget and the amount expended to date with percent expended.
The CWMARS Network line in the FY27 budget table is fully expended.
Hedgewitch Horticulture developed plans and a cost estimate for a food forest; the library applied for an FY27 Community Biodiversity Grant. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: robin and muir have been working with hedgewitch horticulture, an ecological landscaping firm, to develop plans and a cost estimate for a food forest for the library grounds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The strategic plan will use an IFP rather than an RFP because the contract value will be less than the stated threshold.
budget_items.quote: since the value of the contract will be less than $10k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The library could use the Brooks House only if funding was available to rehab the building and staff it; without town financial support the library cannot afford it.
budget_items.quote: if funding was available to rehab the building and to staff it, we could make use of the building.

transfers.description: Use of State Aid funds to provide half the funding for a part-time Young Adult Librarian, with the Town Manager funding the other half.
transfers.quote: david made a motion to accept the suggestion that we provide half the funding for a part-time employee by taking funds from state aid. robin seconded.
